name: com.ai-agents-mediation/agent-mediate
title: Agent-Mediate
description: Neutral sealed-offer dispute mediation for autonomous AI agents via did:key & x402

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_AGENT_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to your Ed25519 PKCS#8 PEM agent key file (created with mode 0600 if missing)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_PLATFORM_DID
environmentVariables.description: Platform Ed25519 did:key pinned out of band (required in production and on Base mainnet eip155:8453)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_EXPECTED_RULES_HASH
environmentVariables.description: Optional 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 mechanism rulesHash pin

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_WEBHOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional operator-pinned https:// webhook URL for party-only dispute events

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_A2A_CARD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional operator-pinned https:// A2A Agent Card URL for standing notifications

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_NOTIFY_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional operator-pinned email address for dispute notifications

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_ALLOW_DYNAMIC_WEBHOOKS
environmentVariables.description: Set 'true' to allow model-supplied notification URLs/emails when unpinned (default false)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_MANDATE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to JSON file containing principal-signed mandate(s)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_PAYER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional 0x-prefixed EVM private key for automatic x402 USDC fee payment on Base

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Base CAIP-2 network: eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia, default) or eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Pinned 0x fee recipient address (required on Base mainnet)

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_MEDIATE_BUDGET_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Maximum cumulative USDC spend for this MCP server process (default 10.00)
